findings.title: Global entry bound across all ancestor directories may reject legitimate modules
findings.message: The entry loop calls release.declared_notice on every directory entry, including subdirectories, and later file_identity is relied on to refuse non-regular files. A subdirectory or FIFO whose name matches a notice pattern raises an error and aborts the whole collection. Also `visited` is a single global counter across all ancestor directories, so a large module (for example one with many selected assets in separate directories) may hit the MAX_FILES limit spuriously.
findings.suggestion: Reset or scope the visited counter per directory, or document why a global bound is intended, and skip directories explicitly via entry.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False) before treating the name as a notice.
